subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: Both arms shall be report-only — they shall detect and report defects and shall mutate no file.
rationale: docgate gate verbs never mutate (docgate-v1#DINV-3); the guard observes, it does not repair
fit_criterion: across every fixture run, the working tree is unchanged by either arm; the only writes in a gate run are the sanctioned projection writes of other verbs, never these
